meta.notes: Import this workflow into n8n. Prerequisites: 1) Create an HTTP Header Auth credential in n8n: Header Name = 'X-FreeScout-API-Key', Header Value = your FreeScout API key (get from FreeScout → Manage → API Keys). 2) Verify mailboxId (default 1 = first mailbox). 3) Activate the workflow. 4) In Tactical RMM → Alerts → Alert Templates → set webhook URL to the n8n webhook URL shown after activation.
